Flood route tests walk to high ground BEFORE starting the warning, so they prove walkability and peak refuge safety, not escape while water rises. The map tornado-reach test accepts distance <=15m while the runtime influence radius defaults to 8m; this assertion is not proof of actual exposure (no safe-camping exploit reproduced). Archived evidence also lacks Phase 4-specific 2/4-player profiles for both maps; native Windows/GPU 60FPS, physical audio/Internet feel and human Normal/Hard cause recognition/escape/rematch comparisons remain unverified. Preserve the existing human waiver and historical archive; do not retroactively claim these gates passed or start Phase 5 implementation.
